newsitem.title: USA: ICC orders on Ameritech, AT&T case.
newsitem.headline: ICC orders on Ameritech, AT&T case.

text.p: The Illinois Commerce Commission said on Tuesday that it entered an order in the arbitration case between Ameritech Illinois and AT&T over inter-connection of the two companies' telephone networks.

The order settles 31 issues the two companies were unable to solve during more than six months of negotiations, the ICC said. They began talks on interconnecting their telecommunications networks in February.
The companies are to incorporate the issues into a new contract and return it the the Commission within 15 days for final ratification, the ICC said.
Inter-connection is required by the Telecommunications Act of 1996 and will allow customers to choose a local telephone carrier.
The ICC said the arbitration order sets terms, conditions and interim pricing for inter-connecting the two networks.
